_meta.title: Stateless people by country
_meta.what: Number of stateless people (no nationality recognised by any country) reported in each country at the end of the year, by UNHCR. "0" means UNHCR reports zero or no data; many countries do not count stateless people, so a zero is often missing data, not proof of none. The other population figures UNHCR gives for the same row are kept. 2024 figure kept for comparison.
_meta.source: UNHCR Refugee Data Finder (Refugee Population Statistics Database), population API
